{{Top|leg}}
A '''creativity damper'''<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''creative damper'''<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> was a device that was installed in [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="SWS" /> Used alongside [[Behavioral inhibitor/Legends|behavioral inhibitor]] circuits and software, creativity dampers were meant to keep droids from reaching true self-awareness.<ref name="Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] required creativity dampers in order to ensure that their [[Language/Legends|language]] translations were unembellished and accurate.<ref name="SWS" /> [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] was forced to install creativity dampers in their [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The droid [[I-5YQ]] had his creativity dampers removed.<ref name="Twilight" />
